Use the named constructors read, content, nav, action, toggle, input, inputActions, control, choices, optionCards, stepper, select, and add so new call sites select one field capability explicitly. CatchField.content maps React body semantics without changing legacy Flutter body-as-value rows. The deprecated expanding and actions facades are removed; call sites must choose the current constructor that expresses their capability.

Trailing affordances are derived by the constructor contract: read, action, and direct input never synthesize a chevron; actionable nav derives a fixed chevron; control, choices, stepper, inputActions, and select derive rotating disclosure glyphs. Existing nav callers may still supply showChevron while they migrate to structural action or nav constructors.

Explicit-save compatibility order is editor, supporting metadata, feedback, secondary action, then Cancel and Done. Validation/helper/counter support is a root sibling after disclosure controls and the commit bar, matching the React handoff. Field-caption color is resolved once at the root: actual error uses danger, active focus or open disclosure uses semantic ink, and inactive state uses the configured tone or ink3. Optional suffix copy remains ink3. Focus never changes label size, weight, baseline, or position.

Press feedback begins on header pointer down; disclosure ownership transfers once on pointer up. The full-row disclosure drawer is a sibling below that header, so nested chips, steppers, and commit buttons cannot trigger header press tint and retain complete hit/focus geometry. Coordinated pressed and active layers use one contextual silhouette: standalone and divided fields paint a rounded tint plus outline, while contained rows paint rectangular internal bands beneath one section-owned group clip. CatchFieldGeometryScope separately publishes content-gutter ownership, interaction bleed, and interaction-shape ownership; divided rows retain their tile overlap, while contained edge rows overlap the section's consumed border inset by exactly one hairline so both primitives paint one shared left/right edge. Explicit-save tap-away cancels on pointer up only when movement remains within touch slop, while drag/scroll leaves the field open and loading blocks Cancel or Escape. Ordinary inputs retain Flutter's shared EditableText tap group for affiliated actions and place the native cursor during the first gesture.
